WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE PARTNERS OF ZU I INVESTMENTS ON 23 rd OCTOBER , 2018 
 
 
 The undersigned, being the founding Partners of ZU I Investments (the “ Firm ”), hereby consent to and adopt in writing the following resolutions as of this 23 rd day of October 2018 : 
 
 Resolved that bank accounts in PKR be opened with Habib Bank Limited (the “ Bank ”) for the Firm, duly registered under the laws of Pakistan . 
 
 Resolved further that the First and Second Partner, namely Mr. Usman Zafar Cheema s/o Zafar Mahmood Cheema and Mr. Zeeshan Ali Khan s/o Shahid Ali Khan , be hereby jointly authorized to accept, sign, execute, deliver and complete all documentation, agreements, account opening forms, and to do all such acts as may be necessary on behalf of the Firm, from time to time, in order to apply for and avail and operate the banking facilities provided by the Bank. 
 
 Resolved further that Mr. Usman Zafar Cheema and Mr. Zeeshan Ali Khan be hereby jointly authorized as signatories on all accounts of the Firm held with the Bank. 
 
 We, the Partners of ZUI Investments, agree to passing of the above resolutions and subscribe our signatures in token of our consent on this 2 3 rd day of October 2018. 
 
 Partner 
 Signature 
 Usman Zafar Cheema 
 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan 
 
 Muhammad Iqbal
